title.en: Luohu Old Town Food Crawl (Full Day)

bestFor.zh-Hans: 情侣 / 三五好友、吃货、想一次尝遍多款小吃
bestFor.en: Couples or small groups of friends, foodies, and anyone who wants to sample lots of snacks in one go

tips.zh-Hans: 避开 12:00–14:00 及 18:00–20:00 两个高峰；东门小吃多为一人份，建议 3–4 人分着吃、多点几款。
tips.en: Skip the two rush windows, 12:00–14:00 and 18:00–20:00. Dongmen snacks are mostly single portions, so bring 3–4 people and share so you can try more.

name.zh-Hans: 东门老街 / 东门町美食街
name.en: Dongmen Old Street / Dongmen-cho Food Street（东门老街 / 东门町美食街）

desc.zh-Hans: 老街牌坊、骑楼街景；东门町聚集牛杂、烤生蚝、肠粉、甜品等小吃
desc.en: Old-street archway and arcade-house streetscapes. Dongmen-cho is packed with snacks like beef offal, grilled oysters, rice rolls, and sweet soups.

name.en: Xiangxi Village / Caiwuwei（向西村 / 蔡屋围）

desc.zh-Hans: 潮汕砂锅粥、卤水拼盘、烧腊；本地人的夜宵场
desc.en: Chaoshan clay-pot congee, braised-meat platters, and Cantonese roast meats. A late-night spot the locals love.

desc.zh-Hans: 饭后逛商场、买伴手礼（Ole' 超市）；地铁大剧院站直达
desc.en: After dinner, browse the mall and grab souvenirs (Ole' supermarket). Right by Grand Theater Station（大剧院站）on the metro.

name.en: KK TIME / MixC Food Hall（万象食家）

desc.zh-Hans: 新式餐饮楼层，可作夜宵或甜品收尾
desc.en: A trendy dining floor, perfect for a late-night bite or a sweet finish to the day.

name.en: Dongmen Old Street Snacks（东门老街小吃）

category.zh-Hans: 广式小吃 / 街头小吃

mustTry.en: beef offal, rice noodle rolls, grilled oysters, and sweet soups

title.zh-Hans: 深圳世界之窗 门票 / 夜场票
title.en: Window of the World Shenzhen Tickets / Night Session (深圳世界之窗)

merchant.en: Window of the World Shenzhen (深圳世界之窗)

summary.zh-Hans: 全天成人约 ¥220、夜场约 ¥120；1.2 米以下及 70 岁以上免费。网上提前购票通常比现场便宜。
summary.en: All-day adult tickets are about ¥220, night session about ¥120. Free for kids under 1.2m and seniors over 70. Booking online in advance is usually cheaper than at the gate.
